descriptions.notStarted: It's time for me to receive the last test given by #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k in order for me to become the Knight-in-Training.
descriptions.inProgress: An eternal loyalty towards the Empress. The courage to stand up to the Black Mage. The will power required to help me keep my faith in tact. As long as I don't forget these three, I'll be able to fight until the very end as a proud member of Cygnus Knights.
